scope: Five 2KI persons_3 profiles whose prior Wikipedia-null audit found suitable article-body sources. This delta review rereads current draft/evidence, pinned WEB source witnesses, article bodies and source gates; it does not replace a full profile review.

wikipedia.title: Nethaniah
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、列王記下25章に記されるイシュマエルの父ネタヌヤを、同名のほかの人物と分けて挙げています。

primaryChecks.text: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

rows.reasonJa: WEB25:23 identifies this person only as Ishmael’s father; 25:25 describes Ishmael’s action, not Nethaniah’s. The current profile correctly labels him as father, but the summary/fact center the son. Article disambiguation lines 94–98 explicitly separates the 2 Kings father from two same-name people. Keep link and gate; make the prose unmistakably relational if the profile is intended as an individual entry.
rows.unresolved: Nethaniah profile framing should keep son’s actions explicitly relational.

wikipedia.title: Nimshi
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、列王記下9章のエフーとニムシの系譜表現を扱い、親子・祖先のどの関係かを一つに確定していません。

primaryChecks.text: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.
So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;
The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

rows.reasonJa: WEB9:2, 9:14 and 9:20 repeat the Jehu/Nimshi lineage wording. The profile correctly avoids choosing biological father versus ancestor/clan. The current article body lines 105, 109–110 discusses the same Nimshi and explicitly presents the exact relationship as uncertain; article linkage is suitable but the biblical relation remains qualified.
rows.unresolved: Identity/relationship limited to what the related article actually states.

wikipedia.title: Pekah
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版のペカ記事は、ペカの父をレマルヤと記しています。

primaryChecks.text: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.
In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.
Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

rows.reasonJa: WEB15:25/27/30/32/37, 16:1/5 consistently names Pekah as son of Remaliah. The linked Pekah article infobox/lead lines 160–161 says Pekah’s father is Remaliah; it supports relation only, not a separate biography, matching related-section/identity false/relation true.
rows.unresolved: Identity/relationship limited to what the related article actually states.

wikipedia.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、列王記下19:37のシャレゼルをセンナケリブの子の一人として挙げています。

primaryChecks.text: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

rows.reasonJa: WEB19:37 names Sharezer with Adrammelech as Sennacherib’s assailants. The L–Z list’s Sharezer subsection lines 1432–1436 explicitly identifies the 2 Kings/Isaiah figure as Sennacherib’s son; the current exact subsection and same-verse gate are accurate.

wikipedia.title: Pharaohs in the Bible
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、列王記下17:4のエジプト王ソをオソルコン4世とする説と、サイスを指すとする説を紹介しています。

primaryChecks.text: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

rows.reasonJa: WEB17:4 calls So “king of Egypt” but does not identify him historically. The Bible pharaoh article lines 191–193 treats this exact So and reports both the common Osorkon IV identification and the Sais/Tefnakht proposal; it does not settle identity. Related-only link, explicit uncertainty and 17:4 gate are appropriate.
rows.unresolved: Identity/relationship limited to what the related article actually states.
